modify.note: HubSpot: add an opt-in mapping from booking data to HubSpot Meeting properties at meeting creation. Store the enable switch and field mappings in the HubSpot app configuration using the shared CRM enums and schemas, and expose them in the app card through the split WriteToObjectSettings types, utilities, and UI. Keep the existing meeting creation fields and organizer information intact when mappings are absent or disabled. In CrmService, read configuration through `getAppOptions` and fetch the available Meeting properties from HubSpot before building the extra property payload. Skip configured properties that do not exist on the Meeting object. Resolve each configured value by its declared type and source: literal text, booking-field placeholders, UTM placeholders, booleans, phone values, or booking dates. Support placeholders inside surrounding text and as the whole value, and define a consistent empty-value behavior when the requested booking data is unavailable. Convert dates and other typed values to the representation the existing HubSpot integration expects before merging the mapped properties into the create request. Respect the configured write policy and keep missing optional tracking or form answers from corrupting the ordinary meeting payload.
